narrative: Opening the document downloads a HTML Application (.HTA) file with embedded JavaScript that decrypts and executes the payload. Once launched, the malicious payload collects data about the local system and exfiltrates it to a remote server using api[.]trello[.]com. Data collected by the malware was exfiltrated via HTTP POST requests to *.m.pipedream[.]net hostnames.
